text: When a pilot reports TCAS RA, controller shall not attempt to modify the aircraft's flight path until the pilot reports clear of conflict. Once an aircraft departs from an ATC clearance in compliance with a resolution advisory RA or a pilot reports an RA, the controller ceases to be responsible for providing separation. Question. Who is responsible for separation when a TCAS RA is alerted?
